summary_en: Tender offer by SBINM LLC (wholly-owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings) to acquire up to 23.8M shares at ¥340/share (20.67% of voting rights) during Aug 31–Sep 30, 2026 (extendable to Oct 15). Purpose: associate company under equity method. Board supports offer; shareholders' decision on participation is neutral. Listing on TSE Growth market will be maintained post-offer. Concurrent capital and business partnership agreement with SBI Holdings.
title_en: Notice of Support for and Expression of Neutral Opinion on Tender Offer for Our Shares by SBINM LLC and Conclusion of Capital and Business Partnership Agreement with SBI Holdings Inc.
translation_en_brief: BASE Inc. announced on 28 August 2026 that its board has resolved to support a tender offer by SBINM LLC, a wholly-owned subsidiary of SBI Holdings Inc., to acquire up to 23,792,300 ordinary shares at ¥340 per share. The offer will run from 31 August to 30 September 2026 (20 business days), extendable to 15 October (30 business days) if an extension request is filed. Upon completion at the upper limit, SBINM's voting-rights stake will be 20.67%, calculated against 1,151,009 voting units as of 30 June 2026 (from BASE's semi-annual report). The purpose is to make BASE an associate company under the equity method. Importantly, the board expressed support for the offer but declared its stance on shareholder participation to be neutral, because the upper limit is capped and the listing on TSE Growth market will be maintained after the offer, giving shareholders a rational option to retain their shares. The board also authorized a concurrent capital and business partnership agreement with SBI Holdings. The tender offer is structured to maintain BASE's listing and is not intended as a delisting.
